text:
Maya: Thanks everyone — quick catch-up thread from today's all-hands. I'll capture the unanswered Qs, owners, and links. TL;DR: roadmap shuffle, Dedicated GA window, quota rollout plan.

Maya: Recording + slides: https://redwood.com/ah/mar-2026-recording  deck: https://redwood.com/ah/mar-2026-slides.pdf

Morgan: Short answers to the top asks: Dedicated GA target = mid-May (tentative). Quota changes will start rolling next week. More detail in the follow doc: https://redwood.com/roadmap/ga-notes

Priya: Roadmap clarity — async batching moved into Q3 to free up infra cycles. We'll surface perf blockers and expected customer impact by EOD Thursday.

Leo: I'm owning infra perf work (async batching perf, kernel tuning). I'll spin up an RFC + perf baseline PR tomorrow morning.

Sarah: SDK changes are backward-compatible except one minor param rename. Migration guide here: https://redwood.com/devex/sdk-migration.md Office hours planned Tue 9am PT — invite to go out.

Jordan: Pricing for Dedicated — can sales get the final sheet? @Alex (Finance) ?

Alex (Finance): Published a draft pricing spreadsheet here: https://redwood.com/finance/dedicated-pricing-draft.xlsx  I'll finalize and post to #sales by Friday EOD. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Action items I'm taking: compile owners, add Jira tickets, and confirm GA freeze dates. I'll ping owners if I don't see PRs by Thursday.

Maya: Raw action list:
- Dedicated GA window confirmation -> Morgan
- Pricing finalization -> Alex (Finance)
- Infra RFC + baseline -> Leo
- SDK migration doc + office hours -> Sarah
- Eval testcases for batching -> Priya

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded to internal drive and transcript generated. :robot_face:

Leo: Quick note — can we prioritize a small canary with 3 customers for GA? reduces blast radius.

Morgan: Good call @Leo. Work with SolutionsEng to pick candidates. I'll also ask Legal to prep contractual language for Dedicated customers.

Sarah: Added the migration checklist to the SDK doc (see section 3). Minimal code snippet:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(region="us-west2")
```

Priya: If anyone flagged duplicate items in the thread, add them to this thread or ping me. I'll scrub and ensure owners are set.

Maya: I'll post a short follow-up doc with ticket links and dates in 24 hours. Thanks all. :pray:
